steps.name: Validate and extract exact approved snapshot
Fetch pinned runtime and locked dependencies without application execution
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
docker pull "$NODE_IMAGE"
docker image inspect "$NODE_IMAGE" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-evidence/runtime-image.json"
docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  --env HOME=/tmp --env npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-deps,dst=/deps" --workdir /deps \
  "$NODE_IMAGE" npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-evidence/npm-ci.log"

steps.name: Run frontend gates with no network or credentials
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
docker run --rm --init --network none --read-only --cpus 2 --memory 5g --memory-swap 5g --pids-limit 256 \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=512m --env HOME=/tmp --env CI=true \
  --env "CRUIXE_COMMIT=$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-source,dst=/work" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-deps/node_modules,dst=/work/node_modules" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-evidence,dst=/evidence" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$REVIEW_PATH/review-manifest.json,dst=/review-manifest.json,readonly" \
  --workdir /work "$NODE_IMAGE" node --max-old-space-size=256 qa-ci/run-remote.mjs \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cruixe-evidence/remote-run.log"

steps.name: Record summary even when a gate fails
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,shutil
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'cruixe-evidence';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
result=folder/'readiness.json'
if not result.exists():
  result.write_text(json.dumps({'frontendIntegration':'NO-GO','productionRelease':'NO-GO','gates':{k:{'status':'NOT RUN','reason':'Runner setup or dependency installation did not complete'} for k in ['typescript','vitest','eslint','productionBuild','network','source','screenshots','remoteBrowser']},'authenticatedE2E':{'status':'BLOCKED','reason':'No approved staging'}},indent=2))
baseline=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'cruixe-source/qa-ci/historical-edge-baseline'
if baseline.is_dir():
  target=folder/'historical-edge-baseline';target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  for item in baseline.iterdir():
    if item.is_file() and not (target/item.name).exists(): shutil.copyfile(item,target/item.name)
  (target/'SCOPE.txt').write_text('Historical isolated Microsoft Edge screenshots; not a fresh remote browser run.\n')
with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'],'a') as summary:
  summary.write('## Isolated CruiXe verification\n\n```json\n'+result.read_text()+'\n```\n')
PY
